TxtVoice is an Android application that provides Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech functionality using Android\'s native speech APIs. Designed with accessibility at its core, it enables seamless communication through visual and vocal interfaces.
TxtVoice needs access to your microphone to transcribe your speech into text. This is a core feature of the app.
Microphone permission has been permanently denied. Please enable it in the app settings to use speech features.

TxtVoice Privacy Policy

1. Introduction
We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how TxtVoice handles your data.

2. Microphone Usage
We access your microphone ONLY to provide Speech-to-Text services while the app is active.

3. Data Storage
We do not store, record, or upload your audio data to any of our servers. All voice processing is done locally on your device or via Google's secure speech APIs.

4. Third-Party Services
We use Google Play Services for speech recognition and text-to-speech synthesis. Please refer to Google's privacy policy for how they handle data.

5. No Data Sharing
We do not sell or share any personal information with third parties.

6. Contact
If you have any questions, contact us at dhruva.bhatt.dev@gmail.com.
